answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because ripple only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any vault approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
